title: CFA Level II
tagline: Read the vignette. Find the answer.
summary: One-to-one CFA Level II coaching built around official item sets, vignette reading, error diagnosis, and real-world application.
audience: Designed for committed CFA Level II candidates who attempt official item sets before each session and want to know exactly why they lose marks. Not a re-teach of Level I, and no pass is guaranteed.
difference:
Vignettes, not formulas.
Level II tests whether you can apply the curriculum inside a page of case text. We train you to find what each question is really asking, then prove it on real data.
duration: 1-on-1 · Abu Dhabi in person or online

method.title: Learn
method.description: Each topic starts with the format that suits the candidate: independent study, tutor-led teaching, or a mix.

method.title: Solve
method.description: Official curriculum item sets are worked through in session. The candidate explains which vignette detail drove each answer, and the cause of each error is identified: reading, concept, formula, calculation, or timing.

method.title: Apply
method.description: Each topic ends with a short practical task, such as a spreadsheet, company report, bond-pricing exercise, or investment decision.

method.title: Revise
method.description: Short, spaced reviews revisit earlier topics through recall quizzes, retried errors, and mixed question sets.

modes.title: Self-study
modes.description:
You read the official curriculum and attempt the item sets on your own schedule. Sessions go straight to what you got wrong or guessed: we trace each error to its cause and agree exactly what to fix before the next session.
Best for: candidates who learn well from the books and want sharp feedback, not more lectures.

modes.title: Tutor-led
modes.description:
I teach each topic live from first principles, with worked examples on a shared whiteboard. You then attempt item sets straight away, while the idea is fresh, and we review your answers together.
Best for: first-time candidates, career switchers, or anyone who finds a topic hard to learn from the text alone.

modes.title: Hybrid
modes.description:
You read first and mark what is unclear. I teach only those parts, then we move to item sets, so no session time is spent re-explaining what you already understand. You can switch mode topic by topic.
Best for: candidates with some background who want the fastest route through the curriculum.

modules.title: Ethical and Professional Standards
modules.summary: Apply the Code and Standards to longer, layered case vignettes and defend the decision.
modules.coaching: Ethics item sets are attempted first. Each answer is traced to the Standard and the vignette detail that decides it.
modules.practice: Work a multi-issue compliance case and rank the violations.
modules.deliverable: One-page case note mapping each issue to a Standard.

modules.title: Equities
modules.summary: Choose and defend the right valuation model for the company in front of you.
modules.coaching: Item sets on DDM, FCFF/FCFE, residual income and multiples are reviewed. Model choice and input errors are diagnosed.
modules.practice: Value a listed company with a two-stage free-cash-flow model and compare it with the market price.
modules.deliverable: Two-stage valuation model with a sensitivity table.

modules.title: Financial Statement Analysis
modules.summary: Adjust reported numbers for intercorporate investments, pensions and multinational operations.
modules.coaching: Item sets are rebuilt step by step, adjustment by adjustment, so each one is explained, not memorised.
modules.practice: Restate a real company’s statements for one accounting choice and show the effect on key ratios.
modules.deliverable: Restated statements with a before-and-after ratio table.

modules.title: Fixed Income
modules.summary: Value bonds with term structure, binomial trees and credit models.
modules.coaching: Questions on curve building, tree setup and credit analysis are reviewed. Errors in discounting and option logic are diagnosed.
modules.practice: Build a binomial interest-rate tree in a spreadsheet and value a callable bond.
modules.deliverable: Binomial tree valuing a callable and a putable bond.

modules.title: Portfolio Construction
modules.summary: Connect multifactor models, risk measures and economics to portfolio decisions.
modules.coaching: Item sets on factor models, VaR and active management are reviewed. Each answer is tied back to the portfolio decision.
modules.practice: Estimate a simple factor model on market data and interpret the exposures.
modules.deliverable: Factor-exposure summary with a short interpretation.

modules.title: Quantitative Methods
modules.summary: Read regression and time-series output the way an analyst does.
modules.coaching: Output-interpretation questions are reviewed. Misread coefficients, tests and model-fit statistics are diagnosed.
modules.practice: Run a multiple regression on real data and test its assumptions.

modules.title: Economics
modules.summary: Link currencies, growth and regulation to valuation and market moves.
modules.coaching: Currency, forward-rate and growth-model questions are reviewed. Each error is traced to the step where the reasoning broke.
modules.practice: Calculate cross rates and a forward premium from live quotes and explain the result.

modules.title: Corporate Finance
modules.summary: Judge capital structure, payout and governance decisions by their effect on value.
modules.coaching: Item sets on capital structure, dividends, ESG and restructuring are reviewed. Calculation and judgement errors are separated.
modules.practice: Assess a real company’s capital structure and payout policy.

modules.title: Derivatives
modules.summary: Price forwards, futures, swaps and options from no-arbitrage first principles.
modules.coaching: Pricing and valuation questions are reviewed. Sign and timing errors in the cash flows are diagnosed.
modules.practice: Price an interest-rate swap from a real yield curve.
modules.deliverable: Swap pricing sheet with a mark-to-market check.

modules.title: Alternative Investments
modules.summary: Value real estate, private capital and commodities on their own terms.
modules.coaching: Questions on property valuation, private equity and commodity returns are reviewed. Look-alike methods are separated.
modules.practice: Value an income-producing property by direct capitalisation and DCF.

options.title: CFA Level II Comprehensive Coaching
options.description: End-to-end guidance through the entire CFA Level II curriculum. Includes a customized study plan anchored to your exam date, item-set practice for every topic, and continuous support from day one to exam day. Flexible payment plans available.

options.title: Targeted Topic Pack
options.description: Focused, intensive coaching on high-weight or complex areas (e.g., Equities, FSA, Fixed Income). Designed to solidify your understanding, fix recurring item-set errors, and improve your scoring in specific problem areas.

options.title: Final-month revision sprint
options.description: An intensive 4-to-6 week program designed for the final stretch before your exam window. Includes thorough mock-exam reviews, vignette time-management techniques, and targeted drills to strengthen your remaining weak areas.

options.title: Single session
options.description: A dedicated one-on-one session to work through difficult item sets, clarify complex models, or untangle a topic that is not clicking. Ideal for targeted, immediate help with no long-term commitment.

faqs.question: How is Level II different from Level I?
faqs.answer: Level I tests whether you know the curriculum. Level II tests whether you can apply it: every question sits inside a vignette, and the marks go to candidates who find the decisive detail quickly. Coaching focuses on that reading skill as much as on the finance.

faqs.question: Are sessions in person or online?
faqs.answer: Both. Sessions are held in person in Abu Dhabi, or live online for candidates in Dubai, elsewhere in the UAE and abroad. Online sessions use a shared screen and whiteboard, so the question work is the same either way. The format can be mixed from week to week.

faqs.question: Can the tutor teach topics, or is it only item-set practice?
faqs.answer: Both are available. Each topic can be studied independently, taught live by the tutor, or handled as a hybrid where the candidate reads first and the tutor covers only the unclear parts. The format can change from one topic to the next.

faqs.question: Is the CFA Institute curriculum still needed?
faqs.answer: Yes. Registered candidates access the curriculum, item sets and mock exams through the CFA Institute Learning Ecosystem. Sessions are built around that material, not around separate notes. Finance in Practice is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by CFA Institute.

faqs.question: Can coaching start at any time, and how are sessions priced?
faqs.answer: Coaching can begin on request, with no fixed cohort start date. Sessions can be booked singly, monthly, or as exam-season support. Fees are discussed after the free Strategy Session, because the scope depends on the candidate’s needs.

faqs.question: Does coaching guarantee a pass?
faqs.answer: No. Results depend on the candidate’s preparation and effort. Coaching improves the quality of practice by finding the cause of each error and a clear next step.
